reason: A3 correctly froze L0-SEMANTIC and current LM-QR after EXP-LOCAL-003/004, but later outcome-independent local studies produced a protocol-valid general endpoint policy before any EXP-DISC-001 input or proposal matrix existed. This prospective amendment permits that subsequently selected EXP-LOCAL-014 finalist to be the fixed local policy for discovery, without changing a discovery candidate, budget, metric, gate or tuning allowance.

evidence_boundary.restriction: Local outcomes may select the common local pipeline because every discovery method receives that identical pipeline. They cannot select, tune, promote or reject a discovery method.

selected_common_local_policy.guarded_endpoint_filter: E4 normalized exponential strict-guard slack CPQR
selected_common_local_policy.answer_authority: unchanged 512-bit refinement and independent 768-bit canonical replay

relation_to_prior_preregistration.superseded_scope: Only A3's pre-materialization selection of the complete common local pipeline is extended from the EXP-LOCAL-003/004 fallback to the later EXP-LOCAL-014 endpoint-policy finalist. The A3 historical bindings and stage-local fallback decisions remain true and mandatory upstream evidence.
relation_to_prior_preregistration.unchanged: All proposal streams, prefixes, candidate controls, family separation, callback budgets, scorer semantics, promotion and kill gates, liveness rules, safety requirements and the two-round discovery tuning limit remain unchanged.

freeze_record_additions: Bind this A4 byte sequence and SHA-256 together with the original card and A1/A2/A3.
Bind EXP-LOCAL-014 T2 decision, summary and raw-manifest hashes in addition to the mandatory EXP-LOCAL-003/004 decisions.
Bind the exact E1 and E4 sources and one canonical options byte string containing every route, integer, boolean and binary64 constant.
Name the selected complete local policy explicitly; no development-only candidate or shadow variant is eligible.
materialization_rule: Commit A4 before creating the local-champion freeze record and before generating any EXP-DISC-001 input, assessor input, proposal matrix or outcome. Thereafter any bound local source or option drift invalidates this experiment.
